body:
A rant on LSD
I was diagnosed with Schizophrenia at age 18. That is just a label to me now. From my perception, a self diagnosis at age 20 of Aspergers Syndrome appears nearly 100% accurate, and Schizophrenia making far less sense.
I took LSD for the first time last week, four nights in a row, two nights accompanied with a familiar entheogen; mushrooms. I have since been more tuned in to my surroundings, and have believed in aliens for years. The stars. I probably don't need to say more on that...
My entire life I have felt like my thoughts are running at light-speed. Now that I consume 5/10,000 of a gram of this entheogen, I can explain my thoughts succinctly. I can easily see the danger in this potent chemical.
